Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.model

Class SqliteBadgeProgressDAO

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.model.SqliteBadgeProgressDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
IBadgeProgressDAO
public class SqliteBadgeProgressDAO extends Object implements IBadgeProgressDAO
SQLite implementation of IBadgeProgressDAO.

Uses a BadgeProgress table keyed by (user_id, badge_id) to track progress, earned status, and goals.
